summary: Preserve persistent releases during target cleanup

delivery.outcome: FixOS126: persistent release/release snapshots cannot be inferred safe from age, mode bits or partial references. Exclude all such trees from automatic target cleanup and reject stale/forged direct removal candidates; report them as preserved owner-managed data.
nonGoals: No deleted-service restoration, service restart or user-data cleanup
No process/reference scanner presented as proof of deletion safety
No unrelated Docker/cache policy or dependencies

architecture.decision: Keep compatibility discovery/removal APIs but make discovery preservation-only and removal fail closed. Preserve all immutable runtime/rollback releases and snapshots; target ladder continues other existing cache tiers and reports protected data.
architecture.rollback: Revert material code only through protected publication; do not restore unsafe automatic release deletion on the host.

validation.evidence: Synthetic old referenced/unreferenced and forged candidates retained; no recursive release payload reads or deletion; CLI reports preservation.
Affected cleanup regression gates and independent exact-head CI.
